findings.note: Lowe is the author. As filed, the bill would have the Secretary of State write rules requiring proof of citizenship to register to vote, to the extent federal law permits, and have registrars send mail applicants a notice of what proof they need. It also lets officials check voter addresses against real-estate records. Referred to the Elections committee on 2025-04-03; no later action shown.

Lowe is the author. As filed, the bill would make voter registration certificates expire after each presidential election (November 30 following the next presidential election) instead of on January 1 of an even-numbered year, and adds a civil penalty. Referred to the Elections committee 2025-04-07; no later action shown.

findings.motion: coauthor of HJR 161, constitutional amendment adding non-citizens to the classes of persons not allowed to vote (bill filed 2025-03-03; date Lowe was added not shown)
findings.note: Lowe is listed as a coauthor. The measure proposed a constitutional amendment adding individuals who are not United States citizens to the classes of persons not allowed to vote. It was reported favorably by the House Elections committee on 2025-04-28 and laid on the table subject to call on 2025-05-09.

findings.passage: Also, the voter rolls are completely outdated. David supports expiring voter registrations. Only living Texans should be voting in Texas.
findings.note: From his answers in a 2024 candidate survey as published on Ballotpedia (written in the third person in his name). He backs expiring voter registrations because of outdated rolls. The same answer says: Without free and fair elections, we don't have a representative form of government. It's time to reform our election laws and procedures.

findings.passage: With decades of elections seeing occurrences of illegal voting, invalid votes are being counted.
findings.note: Campaign site issues page, undated (it refers to the 88th session as past, so 2023-2024). Under the heading ELECTION INTEGRITY it continues: Every illegal, fraudulent, and invalid vote must be stopped, and every legal vote must be vehemently protected. No mention of ID or citizenship proof on this page.
